name: magtag_2.9_grayscale
title: Adafruit MagTag 2.9" grayscale (ESP32-S2), including the 2025 Edition with the SSD1680 display
notes: Partitions (TinyUF2 and CircuitPython agree): nvs 0x9000, otadata 0xe000, ota_0 0x10000 (CircuitPython), uf2 0x2d0000 (TinyUF2, factory app), ffat 0x310000 (CIRCUITPY).
CircuitPython's full .bin covers otadata with 0xFF, which makes the board boot TinyUF2; cpfleet writes an otadata entry selecting ota_0 after every firmware write.
After esptool's software reset the board drops off USB until Reset is pressed, so cpfleet never resets it from esptool.
ROM download mode by hand: hold Boot, press and release Reset, release Boot. USB 303a:0002.
